_comment: Harness-relevant Prometheus series, kept in ONE place so a metric rename
on the rate-control branch is a one-line change here, not a code edit
The scraper keeps a scraped series when its name STARTS WITH one of the
base names below. Prefix matching absorbs any suffix the OpenTelemetry ->
Prometheus exporter appends. Verify the exact names and the `origin` label
against a live scrape before trusting a run; discovered names are written
Verified against a live scrape of spiced v2.4.0-unstable-build.c7460de8c6
Gone since the earlier revision, with the persisted budget they reported:
`lease_acquire_conflicts_total`. The budget is now derived per replica and
never written back, so `adaptive_admission_ratio` is the only coefficient
In cluster mode `adaptive_admission_ratio` is absent until the first lease,
and `adaptive_throttled_total` stays 0 by design: the cluster lowers its
budget rather than charging a heavier weight.
